Class Triangulation

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.TriangulationDef
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a collection of triangles with utility methods for:

  • Performing triangulation operations
  • Finding the closest point or triangle to a given location
  • Checking if a point is contained within any triangle
  • Detecting intersections with other shapes or colliders
public class Triangulation : ShapeList<Triangle>, IList<Triangle>, ICollection<Triangle>, IReadOnlyList<Triangle>, IReadOnlyCollection<Triangle>, IEnumerable<Triangle>, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, IEquatable<Triangulation>

ApplyOffset(Transform2D, Vector2)

DrawGlow(ColorRgba, ColorRgba, int)

Draws the triangulation using a glow-like effect by repeatedly drawing the triangles with interpolated colors between color and endColorRgba.

Parameters

color ColorRgba

The ending color for the glow (last pass).

steps int

Number of passes used to interpolate between colors. Must be >= 1; 1 draws a single pass using color.

DrawLines(LineDrawingInfo, float, bool)

DrawLinesScaled(LineDrawingInfo, float, float)

Draws the outlines of each triangle in the triangulation where each side can be scaled towards the origin of the side.

public void DrawLinesScaled(LineDrawingInfo lineInfo, float sideScaleFactor, float sideScaleOrigin = 0.5)

Parameters

lineInfo LineDrawingInfo

The line drawing information (thickness, color, cap type, etc.).

sideScaleFactor float

The scale factor for each side (0 = No Side, 1 = Full Side).

sideScaleOrigin float

The point along each side to scale from in both directions (0 = Start, 1 = End).

Remarks

Allows for dynamic scaling of triangle sides, useful for effects or partial outlines.

DrawScaled(ColorRgba, float, float, int)

Draws each triangle in the triangulation with scaled sides based on a specific draw type.

public void DrawScaled(ColorRgba color, float sideScaleFactor, float sideScaleOrigin, int drawType)

Parameters

color ColorRgba

The color of the drawn shapes.

sideScaleFactor float

The scale factor of the sides (0 to 1). If >= 1, the full triangle is drawn. If <= 0, nothing is drawn.

sideScaleOrigin float

The origin point for scaling the sides (0 = start, 1 = end, 0.5 = center).

drawType int

The style of drawing applied to each triangle:

  • 0: [Filled] Drawn as 4 filled triangles, effectivly cutting of corners.
  • 1: [Sides] Each side is connected to the triangle's centroid.
  • 2: [Sides Inverse] The start of 1 side is connected to the end of the next side and is connected to the triangle's centroid.

DrawVertices(float, ColorRgba, float)

Draws circles at each vertex of every triangle in the triangulation.

public void DrawVertices(float vertexRadius, ColorRgba color, float smoothness)

Parameters

vertexRadius float

The radius of each vertex circle.

color ColorRgba

The color of the vertex circles.

smoothness float

The smoothness value (0-1). This controls the visual quality of the circle by inversely interpolating the current CircleDef.CircleDrawing.CircleSideLengthRange. A value of 0 uses the maximum side length (fewer sides, less smooth), while 1 uses the minimum side length (more sides, smoother).

This method clears result before processing. Triangles with area greater than or equal to minArea are subdivided by calling Triangle.Triangulate.

Subdivide(Triangulation, float, float, float, float)

Recursively subdivides triangles in this triangulation using area limits, optional random retention, and narrow-triangle rejection, writing accepted triangles into result.

public void Subdivide(Triangulation result, float minArea, float maxArea, float keepChance = 0.5, float narrowValue = 0.2)

Parameters

result Triangulation

The destination triangulation that receives the accepted triangles.

minArea float

Triangles with area smaller than this value are kept without further subdivision.

maxArea float

Triangles with area greater than this value are always subdivided.

keepChance float

The probability of keeping a triangle whose area lies between minArea and maxArea. Values outside the range [0, 1] cause a probability to be derived from the triangle area.

narrowValue float

Triangles considered narrow by this threshold are kept without further subdivision.

Remarks

If the triangulation is empty, the method returns immediately without modifying result. Unlike the other Subdivide overload, this method does not clear result before appending accepted triangles.

ToTriMesh(TriMesh)

Converts this triangulation into a TriMesh by writing each triangle's vertices into dst.

public void ToTriMesh(TriMesh dst)

Parameters

dst TriMesh

The destination mesh that will be cleared and populated with triangle vertex data.

Remarks

Each triangle contributes its vertices in A-B-C order to dst.Triangles.
